propwash.race.gate_hint.title: Gate placed
propwash.race.gate_hint.text: Sneak + right-click the gate with a gate item or the course tool to open the gate menu: size, rotation and redstone signal.
propwash.race.gate_hint.open.tooltip: Opens the lesson “Gate menu” in the flight school. This hint will not appear again.
propwash.race.gate_hint.never.tooltip: Never show this hint again, in any world. “Reset hints” in the Flight school tab of the K menu brings it back.
propwash.guide.hints.reset.tooltip: Shows the first-time hints again – for example the hint after your first gate in a world.
propwash.guide.hints.reset.done: Hints reset – they appear again the next time.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.title: Gate menu: size, rotation, redstone
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.descripti: Open the gate menu: size, rotation, redstone and position
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.step.open: Sneak + right-click a placed gate while holding a gate or the course tool. The menu opens and the gate shows every change live.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.o: With a gate or the course tool in hand
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.step.adju: The mouse wheel changes the selected row, sneak + mouse wheel picks the row. Hold Alt (Mac: Option) to use the mouse.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.t: Mouse wheel: yaw, pitch and roll
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.s: Width and height of the opening: 1 to 16 blocks
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.step.reds: The Redstone tab sets the signal: on or off, pulse length and “Races only”. A pass in flight direction powers the block below the gate.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.p: Redstone tab: signal, pulse, races only
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.l: A pass lights the lamp below the gate
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.p: Pulse: the signal stays on 2 to 100 ticks
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.step.posi: The Position tab moves the gate in steps of 1/16, 1/4 or 1 block. Arrow keys follow your view, Page Up/Down go up and down.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.p: Position tab: X, Y and Z, up to 8 blocks
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.w: Mouse wheel: one step per notch
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.a: Arrow keys follow your view · Page Up/Down: up and down
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.step.free: Freeform gates open the same menu with sneak + right-click: flight direction and redstone signal. The blocks around the opening are the frame.
propwash.guide.scene.gate_menu.callout.f: Same menu: flight direction and redstone signal
